description: This file provides utility functions for environment variable management, package manager detection, and process environment setup within the Playwright project. It defines functions to retrieve environment variables with fallback options, determine the package manager in use, identify if the script is run via npx, and mark processes as running under Playwright Test.

methods.name: export function getFromENV(name: string): string | undefined { getFromENV
methods.description: Retrieves an environment variable by name, checking common fallback keys related to npm configuration, returning a string or undefined.

methods.name: export function getAsBooleanFromENV(name: string, defaultValue?: boolean | undefined): boolean { getAsBooleanFromENV
methods.description: Parses an environment variable as a boolean value, with support for default value.

methods.name: export function getPackageManager() { getPackageManager
methods.description: Determines the package manager ('yarn', 'pnpm', or 'npm') based on the npm config user agent.

methods.name: export function getPackageManagerExecCommand() { getPackageManagerExecCommand
methods.description: Returns the appropriate command to execute scripts with the detected package manager.

methods.name: export function isLikelyNpxGlobal() { isLikelyNpxGlobal
methods.description: Checks if the script appears to be run via npx based on process arguments.

methods.name: export function setPlaywrightTestProcessEnv() { setPlaywrightTestProcessEnv
methods.description: Sets an environment variable indicating that the process is under Playwright Test.
